cards.name: Montreat Clubs
cards.description: Children and teenagers participate in games, music, crafts, boating, creek activities and hikes with counselors.
cards.review_notes: The primary page https://montreat.org/clubs returned no readable content. Check that page or its registration platform for dates, separate age bands, prices, hours and actual drop-off addresses. The published age range of two years through graduated high school seniors combines Clubs and Childcare, so it was not assigned to Clubs alone. The 2027 Worship & Music page mentions continued availability but does not post the Clubs season dates.

cards.name: Childcare
cards.description: Summer daytime childcare for children ages two and three.
cards.review_notes: Daytime ages two and three are stated in the official MYC Guidebook search result, which is not explicitly year-dated. The primary Clubs page could not be read. Check the registration platform for the childcare season, hours, prices and drop-off location. Official materials also mention evening childcare for conference participants, but no finite evening schedule was readable, so no separate evening card was created.
